hypothesis: The W01 host evaluator rejects unsupported or manufactured real-60 evidence and reports truthful gate status under the frozen acceptance contract, without hiding invalid intervals or treating synthetic fixtures as device results.
scope: Independently inspect the exact W01-BUILD-001 patch and worktree implementation, full focused tests, command log, SHA256SUMS, handoff and producer-gap note. Do not rely on the worker's summary as proof; reconstruct decisive failures by running the tests and at least one adversarial host fixture of your own.

Check semantics of distinct guest/render/present IDs, complete export, dropped/duplicate/stale records, phase/coverage selection, frame interval and p99/1%-low/5-second window calculations, long stalls, guest speed, identity/provenance, power availability and synthetic/live separation against WORKER.md and acceptance.json.

Pay special attention to false PASS from self-reported IDs or test fixtures, missing acceptance title/executable identity, re-polled histories, surface/session resets, frames outside scored windows, very short runs, counter overflow and missing raw data. Verify no-argument summarizer returns a non-success without demonstration numbers.

Review method-only scope. There is no native per-frame producer, APK/core build, device capture, measured FPS or candidate. An approval may authorize integration/continued instrumentation only; it cannot be a GOW3 performance or device-test approval.

Do not edit implementation or worker raw evidence. Write an independent review with source-located findings, separate method/correctness/performance/save/efficiency verdicts, exact hashes and one scoped decision.
required_tests: re-run focused host tests with exit codes
verify worker patch/result hashes and original dirty source unchanged
deliverables: independent review Markdown with scoped decision
private result.json and host test/evidence log
authorized_budget: One 45-minute read-only host review; no device/network/build/source edit.
